items.q: [INTERVIEWER] According to Leonard Feather and John Chilton's Johnny Shul-ton's book, you went to New York in either August or September of 1929

ctx.x: According to Leonard Feather and John Chilton's Johnny Shul-ton's book, you went to New York in either August or
